findings.title: Axes underdetermine reasonCodes and errorCodes; D6 only proves class
findings.detail: Six axis-collision groups among 39 goldens. Notable: (1) analysis-verdict-indeterminate and baseline-compare-unsupported-recipe share identical axes but emit VERDICT.INDETERMINATE vs BASELINE.RECIPE_UNSUPPORTED — different remedies. (2) coverage-missing vs required-provider-unavailable share axes with different COVERAGE.* codes. (3) four query identity cases share axes including EXPIRED vs UNKNOWN, so invariant-identity-expiry (EXPIRED requires tombstone) is not an axis predicate. The pure derivation is a class function; code faithfulness is still author-authored mutual consistency — the same trap class that blind axes caught in v1.3, moved one level down.
findings.requiredFix: Either extend axes with a closed domainCondition/reason discriminator that derive maps to codes, or add a second pure function reasonFromAxes with golden checks (D10). TombstoneFound must be an axis if EXPIRED is claimable.

findings.title: serve-graceful-signal-stop sets interruption=signal-before-finalization while derive ignores interruption for serve
findings.detail: Independent axes: interruption=none, domainCondition=graceful-signal-stop. Author: interruption=signal-before-finalization. derive() short-circuits on commandKind==serve before reading interruption, so both yield success. If rule order ever checks interruption first, cooperative serve stop becomes class interrupted (exit 130) — contradicting nonAnalysisDerivation and product meaning. Dead axes that would flip under reorder are false inputs even when class matches today.
findings.requiredFix: Set interruption=none on serve clean/graceful stops. Add a checker invariant: for commandKind=serve, interruption must be none (or serve-specific enum value that is not user-interrupt).

findings.title: user-interrupt-finite models lifecycle=coherent-terminal-run for a never-sealed interrupt
findings.detail: Independent model: lifecycle=cannot-seal-coherent-run (interrupt prevented a coherent terminal seal). Author: coherent-terminal-run. Class still interrupted because interruption short-circuits. Faithfulness of lifecycle axis is weak; prefer cannot-seal or an explicit cancelled lifecycle value.
findings.requiredFix: Align lifecycle with 'no coherent sealed Run' for pre-finalization interrupts.

findings.title: query-required-completeness-missing uses COVERAGE.REQUIRED_RELATION_MISSING instead of QUERY.COMPLETENESS_UNMET
findings.detail: codeVocabulary declares QUERY.COMPLETENESS_UNMET with remedy 'relax the completeness requirement or widen scope', distinct from COVERAGE.REQUIRED_RELATION_MISSING ('widen scope so the relation can be derived'). The golden emits the latter. Per the artifact's own rule, two remedies behind one code (or unused specific code) is a smell/defect. Completeness requirement failure is caller-policy, not missing relation derivation.
findings.requiredFix: Emit QUERY.COMPLETENESS_UNMET for that golden; add a golden that uses COVERAGE.REQUIRED_RELATION_MISSING for analysis-scope cases only.

findings.title: Three reason codes declared never used in goldens
findings.detail: COVERAGE.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, COVERAGE.LANGUAGE_TIER_UNSUPPORTED, QUERY.COMPLETENESS_UNMET have remedies but no golden. LANGUAGE_TIER_UNSUPPORTED is load-bearing for P-4 loud tier and has no termination proof.
findings.requiredFix: Add goldens or drop codes until a scenario exists. Prefer add — P-4 needs the tier code on the wire.
